run_lang_slap_agent: run the SLAP language agent evaluation script with a given task-id and config options
run_general_language_agent_loop: run the GeneralLanguageAgent act loop that maps task-ids to code-lists and executes actions in the environment
run_robot_navigation: run the robot navigation to a target position using navigate_to with blocking mode
run_robot_gripper_control: run the robot gripper open or close commands by switching to manipulation mode
run_slap_config_loading: run the SLAP config loader to load visualization and environment settings from a YAML file
